title: Global and regional burden of measles and vaccine coverage among children under 5 years, 1990−2023: a Global Burden of Disease Study
abstract: Measles remains a leading cause of vaccine-preventable burden among children, particularly in low-income settings. Despite decades of progress, there are indications of measles resurgence due to stagnation in vaccine coverage. Here, using the Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries and Risk Factors Study (GBD) 2023, we systematically assessed measles incidence, mortality, disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and vaccine coverage (measles-containing vaccine 1 (MCV1) and measles-containing vaccine 2 (MCV2)) among children under 5 years of age across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023. Between 1990 and 2019, global measles incidence and mortality declined by approximately 80% and 90%, respectively, but rebounded sharply after 2020, with 15.6 million cases and 118,000 deaths estimated in 2023 (+40% and +12% increases, respectively, between 2019 and 2023). Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia continue to bear the highest burden. Global MCV1 coverage rose from 67.2% in 1990 to 83.6% in 2019 but stalled and declined slightly to 81.0% by 2023; MCV2 coverage increased from 14.4% in 1990 to 68.4% in 2019 and reached 71.4% by 2023. Several regions remain well below the Immunization Agenda 2030 (IA2030) target of 90% coverage. The recent measles resurgence underscores the fragility of global immunization progress and the urgent need to restore routine vaccination, close immunity gaps and strengthen outbreak preparedness.

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

analysis_zh.main_results: 模型参数是根据西多阿佐市 2023 年每周的 监测 数据使用粒子群优化 (PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波器、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差 (MAPE) 进行评估。PSO 实现了最低的 MAPE (11.17%),优于其他方法。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 估计的 R0 = 0.668 确认无病状态。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 麻疹 在印度尼西亚仍然是一个重大的公共卫生挑战,特别是在 麻疹 覆盖范围不均匀且免疫力下降的地区。

title: Immunopathogenetic Features of Measles in Adults: Association of Vaccination Status with Measles-Specific IgM Levels and Cytokine Profile (IL-1β, IL-10)
abstract: Olha Matviiuk,1,2 Oleksandra Pryshliak,1,2 Oleksandr Boichuk,1,2 Ihor Hryzhak,1,2 Zoriana Tylishchak,1,2 Taras Kobryn,1,2 Ruslan Miziuk,1,2 Petro Gerych3,41Department of Infectious Diseases and Epidemiology, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine; 2Municipal Non-Commercial Enterprise "Center for Infectious Diseases”, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine; 3Department of Internal Medicine No. 1, Clinical Immunology and Allergology Named After Academician E.M. Neiko, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine; 4Interdepartmental Scientific Laboratory, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, UkraineCorrespondence: Olha Matviiuk, Department of Infectious Diseases and Epidemiology, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine, Email yaciv.olya@gmail.comBackground: The influence of prior measles vaccination on humoral and cytokine immune responses during acute measles in adults remains insufficiently characterized. This study evaluated measles-specific IgM antibody levels, the early dynamics of interleukin (IL)-1β and IL-10, and their associations with hematological parameters according to documented vaccination status.Methods: This single-center observational study included 80 adults with clinically compatible measles and positive measles-specific IgM results who were hospitalized 3– 5 days after disease onset with moderate or severe illness. Patients were classified as having documented prior measles vaccination (n = 40) or no documented evidence of prior measles vaccination (n = 40). Measles-specific IgM antibodies were measured by ELISA on day 7 after rash onset. Serum IL-1β, IL-10, total leukocyte count, and relative lymphocyte percentage were assessed at admission and on day 3 of hospitalization. Non-parametric statistical methods were applied for group comparisons and correlation analyses. An additional regression analysis was performed to assess between-group differences in IL-10 after adjustment for disease severity.Results: Patients with documented vaccination had significantly higher measles-specific IgM levels. IL-1β decreased and IL-10 increased significantly from admission to day 3 in both groups, with no between-group differences in IL-1β. In unadjusted analyses, IL-10 was higher in patients without documented vaccination at both time points. After adjustment for disease severity, the IL-10 difference at admission was no longer significant, whereas the difference on day 3 remained significant. Strong positive correlations between IL-1β and IL-10 were observed in both groups, while IgM correlated positively with relative lymphocyte percentage in patients without documented vaccination.Conclusion: Documented prior measles vaccination was associated with higher measles-specific IgM levels, while the between-group difference in IL-10 on day 3 persisted after adjustment for disease severity. IL-1β dynamics were similar between the groups. These findings demonstrate differences in immune-response patterns between adults with documented prior measles vaccination and those without documented evidence of vaccination, while supporting cautious interpretation of these associations.Keywords: measles, cytokines, vaccination, immunopathogenesis, immunoglobulin, risk factor, disease outcome
journal: Dove Medical Press (Taylor and Francis Group)

analysis.study_design_and_population: This single-center observational study included 80 adults with clinically compatible measles and positive measles-specific IgM results who were hospitalized 3–5 days after disease onset with moderate or severe illness. Patients were classified as having documented prior measles vaccination (n = 40) or no documented evidence of prior measles vaccination (n = 40).
analysis.methods: Measles-specific IgM antibodies were measured by ELISA on day 7 after rash onset. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of prior measles vaccination on immune responses during acute measles in adults. It evaluated measles-specific IgM levels and cytokine profiles (IL-1β and IL-10) in 80 hospitalized adults with measles, divided into two groups based on vaccination status. Results showed higher IgM levels in vaccinated individuals, while IL-1β decreased and IL-10 increased in both groups. After adjusting for disease severity, the IL-10 difference on day 3 remained significant. The study highlights differences in immune-response patterns between vaccinated and unvaccinated adults, though its single-center observational design limits generalisability. These findings may contribute to understanding measles immunopathogenesis and inform future research or clinical strategies for adults with varying vaccination histories.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查成人急性 麻疹 期间先前的 麻疹 疫苗接种 对体液和细胞因子 免疫应答 的影响,因为这一点尚未充分表征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项单中心观察性研究纳入了 80 名临床上符合 麻疹 且 麻疹 特异性 IgM 结果呈阳性的成年人,他们在中度或重度疾病发作后 3-5 天住院。患者被分类为有记录的既往 麻疹 疫苗接种 (n = 40) 或没有记录的既往 麻疹 疫苗接种 证据 (n = 40)。
elements_zh.methods: 在皮疹发作后第 7 天通过 ELISA 测量 麻疹 特异性 IgM 抗体。入院时和住院第 3 天评估血清 IL-1β、IL-10、白细胞总数和相对淋巴细胞百分比。采用非参数统计方法进行组间比较和相关分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 记录有 疫苗接种 的患者的 麻疹 特异性 IgM 水平显着较高。从入院到第 3 天,两组的 IL-1β 均显着下降,IL-10 显着升高,但组间 IL-1β 没有差异。在两组中均观察到 IL-1β 和 IL-10 之间存在强正相关性,而在没有 疫苗接种 记录的患者中,IgM 与相对淋巴细胞百分比呈正相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,有记录在先的 麻疹 疫苗接种 的成年人和没有记录在案的 疫苗接种 证据的成年人之间的免疫反应模式存在差异,强调需要谨慎解释这些关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于理解 麻疹 的免疫反应模式,可能有助于为具有不同 麻疹 病史的成年人制定有针对性的诊断或治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到单中心设计和观察性质的限制,这可能会影响普遍性。由于缺乏随机性和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review explores the potential role of measles virus in the aetiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), focusing on its interactions with other neurotropic viruses and how these may influence MS susceptibility. The central question is whether viral co-exposures, including measles virus, act synergistically to shape MS development in genetically predisposed individuals.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the literature on viral interactions in MS, drawing on epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It does not specify particular databases or search dates, but it includes a broad range of studies examining the role of measles virus and other related viruses in MS.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that measles virus, along with other neurotropic viruses, may play a role in the development of MS through shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections. It highlights that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves multiple viral agents, not just a single pathogen.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that the role of measles virus in MS remains under-researched and that there is contradictory evidence regarding its specific contributions. It also notes that the mechanisms by which measles virus interacts with other pathogens to influence MS susceptibility are not yet fully understood.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions, including those involving measles virus, presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the potential role of measles virus in the aetiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), focusing on its interactions with other neurotropic viruses. It highlights that while measles virus is one of several viral agents implicated in MS, the disease likely results from complex interactions among multiple viruses rather than a single pathogen. The review discusses the available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data, which suggest that viral co-exposures may act synergistically to influence MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. However, the specific mechanisms by which measles virus contributes to this process remain unclear, and further research is needed to characterise these interactions. The review also identifies the need for targeted research on viral networks to develop new preventative strategies and biomarkers for MS.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了 麻疹病毒 在多发性硬化症 (MS) 病因学中的潜在作用,重点关注其与其他嗜神经病毒的相互作用以及这些病毒如何影响 MS 易感性。核心问题是,包括 麻疹病毒 在内的病毒共同暴露是否会协同作用,从而影响遗传易感个体的 MS 发展。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述借鉴了流行病学、免疫学和实验数据,对多发性硬化症中病毒相互作用的文献进行了综合分析。它没有指定特定的数据库或搜索日期,但它包括检查 麻疹病毒 和其他相关病毒在多发性硬化症中的作用的广泛研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,麻疹病毒 以及其他嗜神经病毒可能通过共享分子途径、免疫调节和激活潜伏感染在 MS 的发展中发挥作用。它强调,从感染到自身免疫反应的转变涉及多种病毒因子,而不仅仅是单一病原体。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review explores the potential role of measles virus in the aetiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), focusing on its interactions with other neurotropic viruses and how these may influence MS susceptibility. The central question is whether viral co-exposures, including measles virus, act synergistically to shape MS development in genetically predisposed individuals.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the literature on viral interactions in MS, drawing on epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It does not specify particular databases or search dates, but it includes a broad range of studies examining the role of measles virus and other related viruses in MS.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that measles virus, along with other neurotropic viruses, may play a role in the development of MS through shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections. It highlights that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves multiple viral agents, not just a single pathogen.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that the role of measles virus in MS remains under-researched and that there is contradictory evidence regarding its specific contributions. It also notes that the mechanisms by which measles virus interacts with other pathogens to influence MS susceptibility are not yet fully understood.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions, including those involving measles virus, presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

title_zh: 多发性硬化症和病毒:《危险关系》。
source_body_en: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.
abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分不明。与MS发病相关的风险因素包括遗传易感性和多种环境应激因素;然而,最近病毒感染引起了广泛关注,被认为是重要的环境诱因。尽管已知EB病毒(EBV)与MS易感性之间存在明确的关联,但单一病原体模型无法清晰描述驱动该疾病分子级联反应的机制,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变可能涉及不止一种病毒。在本综述中,我们探讨了不同神经嗜性病毒之间的相互作用可能在MS中发挥协同致病作用的假设,这一领域目前在文献中研究较少。我们总结了不同病毒在MS发病中作用的矛盾证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2,以及水痘-带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2以及人类内源性逆转录病毒(HERVs)。这些病毒可能通过在共享分子通路中的相互作用、免疫调节以及激活潜伏感染,共同影响MS中特征性的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述评估了病毒相互作用在MS病因中的作用,通过这些病原体的累积和交互效应。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据表明,病毒的共同暴露可能在遗传易感个体中协同影响MS的易感性。明确这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过靶向控制病毒网络开发预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

title: Adverse Events Following Varicella-Containing Vaccination in Healthy Children: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
abstract: Background: Varicella-containing vaccines have substantially reduced the burden of varicella worldwide; however, comprehensive evidence on adverse events following vaccination in children remains important for vaccine safety monitoring, vaccine confidence and immunization policy. We aimed to systematically evaluate the incidence of adverse events following licensed varicella-containing vaccination in healthy children. Methods: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating monovalent varicella vaccines or measles–mumps–rubella–varicella (MMRV) vaccines in healthy children aged ≥12 months and <12 years. Eight databases were searched from 1 January 2000 to 17 July 2026. Studies using active safety monitoring and reporting extractable adverse event counts with corresponding denominators were included. Pooled incidence proportions among vaccinated children were estimated using generalized linear mixed models with random effects. Subgroup analyses were performed by vaccine type, vaccination dose, and World Health Organization region. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using the GRADE approach. Results: Forty-three RCTs involving 31,915 vaccinated children were included. Fever was the most frequently reported common adverse event, with a pooled incidence of 11.58% (95% confidence interval [CI], 6.79–19.07%). Pooled incidences were 2.74% (95% CI, 1.10–6.67%) for redness/erythema, 2.19% (95% CI, 0.93–5.06%) for pain, and 0.82% (95% CI, 0.33–1.98%) for swelling. Compared with monovalent varicella vaccines, MMRV vaccines showed higher pooled incidences of fever (43.44% vs. 5.29%), redness/erythema (16.50% vs. 0.69%), pain (12.27% vs. 0.91%), and swelling (7.02% vs. 0.30%); however, these estimates were based on between-study comparisons and should not be interpreted as causal effects of vaccine type. Rare serious adverse events were uncommon, including febrile seizures (0.0989%) and anaphylaxis (0.0343%), with no observed cases of encephalitis. Conclusions: Varicella-containing vaccines were generally well tolerated in children, with most observed adverse events being uncommon and rare serious adverse events infrequently reported. Continued safety surveillance remains important, particularly for rare serious adverse events.

title_zh: 健康儿童中含有水痘的 疫苗接种 后的不良事件:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: Background: Varicella-containing vaccines have substantially reduced the burden of varicella worldwide; however, comprehensive evidence on adverse events following vaccination in children remains important for vaccine safety monitoring, vaccine confidence and immunization policy. We aimed to systematically evaluate the incidence of adverse events following licensed varicella-containing vaccination in healthy children. Methods: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating monovalent varicella vaccines or measles–mumps–rubella–varicella (MMRV) vaccines in healthy children aged ≥12 months and <12 years. Eight databases were searched from 1 January 2000 to 17 July 2026. Studies using active safety monitoring and reporting extractable adverse event counts with corresponding denominators were included. Pooled incidence proportions among vaccinated children were estimated using generalized linear mixed models with random effects. Subgroup analyses were performed by vaccine type, vaccination dose, and World Health Organization region. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using the GRADE approach. Results: Forty-three RCTs involving 31,915 vaccinated children were included. Fever was the most frequently reported common adverse event, with a pooled incidence of 11.58% (95% confidence interval [CI], 6.79–19.07%). Pooled incidences were 2.74% (95% CI, 1.10–6.67%) for redness/erythema, 2.19% (95% CI, 0.93–5.06%) for pain, and 0.82% (95% CI, 0.33–1.98%) for swelling. Compared with monovalent varicella vaccines, MMRV vaccines showed higher pooled incidences of fever (43.44% vs. 5.29%), redness/erythema (16.50% vs. 0.69%), pain (12.27% vs. 0.91%), and swelling (7.02% vs. 0.30%); however, these estimates were based on between-study comparisons and should not be interpreted as causal effects of vaccine type. Rare serious adverse events were uncommon, including febrile seizures (0.0989%) and anaphylaxis (0.0343%), with no observed cases of encephalitis. Conclusions: Varicella-containing vaccines were generally well tolerated in children, with most observed adverse events being uncommon and rare serious adverse events infrequently reported. Continued safety surveillance remains important, particularly for rare serious adverse events.

title: Splitting the Schedule: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Childhood Vaccination Completion and Timeliness With Single-Antigen Versus Combination Vaccines
abstract: Description/ Abstract Recent federal policy has advanced a “split” childhood vaccine schedule, substituting single-antigen vaccines for recommended combination products, including DTaP-containing pentavalent/hexavalent vaccines and MMR. This shift warrants examination in light of current evidence on vaccine delivery in the United States. Individual cohort and survey studies have reported that combination products are associated with higher series completion and more on-time receipt of vaccination (Kurosky et al., Human Vaccines & Immunotherapeutics, 2017). More recently, an Israeli mixed-methods cohort linked single-antigen use to marked delay and non-completion (Sales et al., Vaccines, 2026). Estimates vary in magnitude, and to our knowledge, no pooled effect size exists. With resurgent measles and pertussis outbreaks driven by clustered under-vaccination, these findings have not been quantitatively synthesized. As questions on the childhood vaccine schedule increasingly arise at the point of care, pharmacists must be equipped to offer evidence-based guidance.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluates the impact of substituting single-antigen vaccines for combination vaccines in the childhood vaccination schedule, focusing on measles virus and related entities. The review highlights that combination vaccines are associated with higher series completion and more timely vaccination, based on cohort and survey studies in the United States. The findings suggest that the shift to single-antigen vaccines may contribute to delays and non-completion of the vaccination series, raising concerns about vaccine delivery and public health outcomes. These results emphasize the importance of evidence-based guidance for healthcare providers, particularly pharmacists, in addressing vaccine schedule-related questions at the point of care.

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 根据个体 队列研究 和调查研究的报告,组合 疫苗 与更高的系列完成度和更及时的 疫苗 相关(Kurosky 等人,Human 疫苗 和免疫治疗,2017)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 单抗原 疫苗 对 疫苗接种 完成和及时性的影响的估计在大小上有所不同,并且证据中没有报告汇总效应大小。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,使用单抗原疫苗可能会导致疫苗接种系列的延迟和无法完成,这与公共卫生政策和临床实践相关。这些结果凸显了药剂师和医疗保健提供者需要基于证据的指导。

title: Assessing the Risk for Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak and Health System Response Capacity in Conflict-Affected Sudan
abstract: Background: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever with high case fatality rates. Ongoing regional outbreaks in Uganda and the DRC, combined with protracted armed conflict in Sudan since April 2023, increase vulnerability to importation and spread, putting Sudan at risk. Conflict has caused widespread health infrastructure destruction, healthcare worker displacement, and disruption of surveillance and laboratory systems. This study assesses Sudan’s risk of an EVD outbreak and national response capacity in the context of conflict. Methods: We reviewed peer-reviewed and grey literature using PubMed, Medline, Google Scholar, WHO, CDC, UNICEF, and UN OCHA reports. No time restrictions were applied. We applied a SWOT analysis framework to classify factors influencing EVD prevention, detection, preparedness, and response in conflict-affected Sudan. The analysis focused on health system functionality, surveillance, laboratory capacity, workforce, and population vulnerabilities. Results: Our study found existing strengths, including availability of national EVD preparedness plans, prior experience responding to cholera, dengue, measles, and COVID-19, functional coordination through the Health Cluster, and ongoing disease surveillance systems including EWARS and Event-Based Surveillance. Weaknesses identified include severe disruption of health services (48% of facilities fully functional), health workforce shortages and burnout, disruption of laboratory capacity, and surveillance and access constraints in conflict-affected areas of Darfur and Kordofan. The ongoing health security frameworks, including the National Health Policy, National Health Sector Recovery Plan, and regional cross-border initiatives, expansion of digital surveillance, laboratory decentralization efforts, and recent international investments in health system recovery, provide significant opportunities for optimal preparedness and response. Threats identified include continued armed conflict and insecurity, large-scale internal displacement and cross-border mobility, humanitarian access constraints, and funding instability. Geographic risk synthesis indicates Darfur is at the highest risk for delayed detection and silent transmission, Kordofan serves as a transmission corridor, and Khartoum faces the highest risk of urban amplification. Conclusion: Sudan faces a moderate to high EVD outbreak risk due to potential virus importation, a conflict-weakened health system, and mass displacement. Key priorities: strengthen EWARS in conflict zones, decentralize laboratory capacity, restore health facilities with strong IPC, build workforce capacity, and adopt mobility-informed preparedness. Peace and international support remain essential for effective EVD response.

analysis.summary_en: This review assesses the risk of an Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in Sudan and evaluates the country's health system response capacity amid ongoing conflict. The study highlights the vulnerability of Sudan to EVD importation due to the destruction of health infrastructure, displacement of healthcare workers, and disruption of surveillance systems. While the review identifies strengths such as existing EVD preparedness plans and functional coordination through the Health Cluster, it also notes significant weaknesses, including limited health service functionality, workforce shortages, and challenges in surveillance and access in conflict-affected areas. Peace and international support are deemed critical for an effective EVD response. The review does not report specific controversies or evidence gaps related to the measles virus, but it outlines actionable research and practice implications for EVD prevention and control.

abstract_zh: 背景:埃博拉病毒病(EVD)是一种严重的病毒性出血热,病死率很高。乌干达和刚果民主共和国持续存在的区域性 暴发,加上苏丹自 2023 年 4 月以来旷日持久的武装冲突,增加了输入和传播的脆弱性,使苏丹面临风险。冲突造成了广泛的卫生基础设施破坏、医护人员流离失所以及 监测 和实验室系统的破坏。本研究评估了苏丹发生埃博拉病毒病 暴发 的风险以及冲突背景下的国家应对能力。方法:我们使用 PubMed、Medline、Google Scholar、WHO、CDC、UNICEF 和 UN OCHA 报告审查了同行评审的灰色文献。没有时间限制。我们应用 SWOT 分析框架对影响受冲突影响的苏丹埃博拉病毒病预防、检测、准备和应对的因素进行分类。该分析重点关注卫生系统功能、监测、实验室能力、劳动力和人口脆弱性。结果:我们的研究发现了现有优势,包括国家埃博拉病毒病防范计划的可用性、应对霍乱、登革热、麻疹 和 COVID-19 的先前经验、通过健康集群进行的功能协调以及持续疾病 监测 系统(包括 EWARS 和基于事件的 监测)。发现的弱点包括卫生服务严重中断(48%的设施功能齐全)、卫生人力短缺和倦怠、实验室能力中断以及达尔富尔和科尔多凡受冲突影响地区的 监测 和准入限制。正在进行的卫生安全框架,包括国家卫生政策、国家卫生部门恢复计划和区域跨境举措、数字 监测 的扩展、实验室权力下放工作以及最近对卫生系统恢复的国际投资,为最佳准备和应对提供了重要机会。已确定的威胁包括持续的武装冲突和不安全、大规模境内流离失所和跨境流动、人道主义准入限制以及资金不稳定。地理风险综合表明,达尔富尔面临延迟检测和沉默 传播 的最高风险,科尔多凡充当 传播 走廊,喀土穆面临城市放大的最高风险。结论:由于潜在的病毒输入、因冲突而被削弱的卫生系统和大规模流离失所,苏丹面临着中度至高度的埃博拉病毒病 暴发 风险。主要优先事项:加强冲突地区的 EWARS、分散实验室能力、通过强大的 IPC 恢复卫生设施、建设劳动力能力以及采取流动性知情的准备。和平和国际支持对于有效应对埃博拉病毒病仍然至关重要。

title: Microneedle-Based Transdermal Drug Delivery: Recent Advances and Future Prospects
abstract: Microneedle (MN) systems are emerging as versatile platforms that create micron-scale pathways across the stratum corneum while limiting stimulation of deeper pain receptors and blood vessels. This minimally invasive approach expands transdermal delivery beyond the small, moderately lipophilic molecules traditionally suited to passive patches and enables administration of peptides, proteins, vaccines, poorly soluble drugs, nucleic-acid formulations and locally acting dermatological agents. This review critically examines solid, coated, hollow, dissolving, separable and hydrogel-forming microneedles, with emphasis on how material selection, needle geometry, drug localization and manufacturing method determine insertion reliability, dose capacity, release kinetics and product stability. Recent advances include pure-drug needle tips for high payloads, nanosuspension-loaded dissolving arrays for lipophilic molecules, hydrogel-forming systems coupled with engineered reservoirs, rapidly separating tips for sustained intradermal depots, and additive manufacturing for rapid design optimization. Clinical evidence from influenza, measles-rubella and osteoporosis programmes confirms the translational potential of microarray patches, although local reactions, dose delivery variability and scale-up remain important constraints. Critical quality attributes include morphology, mechanical strength, insertion depth, drug content and distribution, dissolution or swelling, permeation, sterility assurance, packaging integrity and user-applied force. Future progress will depend on integrated quality-by-design development, robust in vitro-in vivo relationships, climate-resilient packaging, human-factor engineering and clearer combination-product regulatory pathways. Microneedles are therefore positioned not merely as an alternative to injections, but as a programmable interface for localized, systemic and responsive therapy.
journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of microneedle (MN) systems as a transdermal drug delivery platform, emphasizing their ability to deliver a wide range of therapeutic agents beyond traditional small molecules. The analysis covers various MN types, including solid, coated, hollow, dissolving, separable, and hydrogel-forming, highlighting how material selection, geometry, and manufacturing influence performance. Recent advancements such as pure-drug tips, nanosuspension-loaded dissolving arrays, and additive manufacturing are noted, along with clinical evidence from influenza, measles-rubella, and osteoporosis programs. Despite their promise, challenges like local reactions, dose variability, and scale-up persist. The review also identifies critical quality attributes and outlines future directions, including quality-by-design approaches, in vitro-in vivo relationships, and regulatory clarity. Microneedles are positioned as a programmable interface for localized and systemic therapy, offering a transformative alternative to injections.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 微针 (MN) 系统正在成为一种多功能平台,可以在角质层上创建微米级的通路,同时限制对更深的疼痛感受器和血管的刺激。这种微创方法将透皮递送扩展到传统上适合被动贴剂的小、中等亲脂性分子之外,并能够施用肽、蛋白质、疫苗、难溶性药物、核酸制剂和局部作用的皮肤病药物。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述严格审查了实心、涂层、空心、溶解、可分离和水凝胶形成的微针,重点是材料选择、针几何形状、药物定位和制造方法如何决定插入可靠性、剂量容量、释放动力学和产品稳定性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 最新进展包括用于高有效负载的纯药物针尖、用于亲脂性分子的纳米悬浮液负载溶解阵列、与工程 储存宿主 相结合的水凝胶形成系统、用于持续皮内储库的快速分离针尖以及用于快速设计优化的增材制造。来自流感、麻疹-风疹和骨质疏松症项目的临床证据证实了微阵列贴片的转化潜力,尽管局部反应、剂量输送变异性和扩大规模仍然是重要的限制因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关键质量属性包括形态、机械强度、插入深度、药物含量和分布、溶解或膨胀、渗透、无菌保证、包装完整性和用户施加的力。未来的进展将取决于综合的质量设计开发、强大的体外体内关系、气候适应性包装、人因工程和更清晰的组合产品监管途径。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 因此,微针不仅可以作为注射的替代品,而且可以作为局部、全身和响应性治疗的可编程接口。

title: HVSnp: A manually curated database of human SNPS associated with viral infections.
abstract: Abstract We developed the “HVSnp: Human Viruses SNP-related database, a curated database”. HVSnp is exclusive to the human SNPs studied and related to viral diseases, with manually mined and curated information from public SNP databases and scientific articles. We used MySQL (version 8.0) due to the easy management and the Looker Studio online availability. Among the output information, we have SNP identification, reference, alternative, and risk alleles, chromosome, gene, and gene function, summary, among others. In total, HVSnp contains eighteen viral diseases and 2020 records: Adenovirus (17 SNPs), Chikungunya (7), COVID-19 (314), Cytomegalovirus (54), Dengue (62), Epstein-Barr (54), Hepatitis A (3), Hepatitis B (380), Hepatitis C (166), Herpes (8), Human immunodeficiency virus (479), Papillomavirus (87), Influenza (74), Measles (68), Respiratory syncytial virus (50), Sars-CoV (80), West Nile (68), and Zika (49). As one SNP can be associated with more than one virus, the number of unique SNPs is 1691 and 651 genes. HVSnp has supplementary information obtained in articles for the summary elaboration, which contains the most significant results described in the literature about a possible relationship between SNPs and viruses. The database is available at URL: https://lookerstudio.google.com/s/pGUC7m538gQ.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a curated database of human SNPs associated with viral infections, addressing the need for a comprehensive resource to understand the genetic basis of viral diseases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the creation of HVSnp, a database containing 2020 records of SNPs related to 18 viral diseases, including measles, using manual curation from public SNP databases and scientific articles.
analysis.methods: HVSnp was developed using MySQL (version 8.0) for database management and Looker Studio for online availability.
analysis.main_results: HVSnp includes SNP identification, reference, alternative, and risk alleles, chromosome, gene, and gene function, with a total of 1691 unique SNPs and 651 genes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The database provides supplementary information from articles to elaborate on the most significant results about the relationship between SNPs and viruses, highlighting the potential genetic basis of viral diseases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HVSnp can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of viral diseases by providing a comprehensive resource for understanding the genetic factors associated with these infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the manual curation process and the potential for bias in the selection of SNPs and viruses, which may affect the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the database.

analysis.summary_en: HVSnp is a curated database of human SNPs associated with viral infections, including 18 diseases such as measles. It provides detailed SNP information and supplementary literature to enhance understanding of genetic factors in viral diseases.

title: Analytical Validation of MethyLiverDx-Sigma, a Plasma cfDNA Methylation Assay for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Detection.
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance relies on ultrasonography and alpha-fetoprotein, both limited in sensitivity for early-stage disease; aberrant methylation of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) offers a promising blood-based approach. Reported here is the analytical validation of MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s), an assay that detects methylated RNF135 and DNMT3A in bisulfite-converted plasma cfDNA by methylation-specific PCR with high-resolution melting (HRM), with GAPDH as an endogenous control. Performance was evaluated following CLSI EP05-A3, EP07, EP12-A2, and EP37. Precision of quantification cycle (Cq) and melting peak temperature (Tm) was assessed by variance-component analysis within one site and across two sites and two operators. Because precision studies used bulk bisulfite-converted reference DNA, the reported coefficients of variation (CVs) primarily characterize the PCR-HRM detection module; end-to-end variability in clinical plasma specimens may be higher. Interference and cross-reactivity were evaluated in low-positive and contrived-negative samples against reproducibility-derived limits, with dose-response testing of reactive substances. Detection was 100% at both levels, and every run met control-validity criteria. Cq repeatability CVs ranged from 0.53% to 1.68%, and total reproducibility CVs ranged from 1.10% to 2.37%; all Tm CVs were ≤0.20%. All 18 interferents and 16 microbial cross-reactants evaluated in low-positive samples met the predefined acceptance criteria. In negative samples, hemoglobin, SARS-CoV-2, and measles virus produced concentration-dependent non-specific amplification, and dose-response testing established their respective no-effect concentrations. These findings characterize the analytical precision and multisite reproducibility of the PCR-HRM detection module and the analytical specificity of MLDx-s, complementing its previously reported clinical performance for plasma-based HCC detection.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved analytical validation of MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s), an assay that detects methylated RNF135 and DNMT3A in plasma cfDNA using methylation-specific PCR with high-resolution melting (HRM). analysis.methods: The analytical validation of MLDx-s was conducted using CLSI EP05-A3, EP07, EP12-A2, and EP37 guidelines. analysis.main_results: Cq repeatability coefficients of variation (CVs) ranged from 0.53% to 1.68%, and total reproducibility CVs ranged from 1.10% to 2.37%. All Tm CVs were ≤0.20%. Additionally, all 18 interferents and 16 microbial cross-reactants met predefined acceptance criteria.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings establish the analytical precision and multisite reproducibility of the PCR-HRM detection module, as well as the analytical specificity of MLDx-s, which complements its previously reported clinical performance for plasma-based HCC detection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for the use of MLDx-s in HCC surveillance, offering a more sensitive and specific alternative to current methods such as ultrasonography and alpha-fetoprotein, which are limited in early detection.

analysis.summary_en: This study validates MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s), a plasma cfDNA methylation assay for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) detection. It highlights the limitations of current HCC surveillance methods, such as ultrasonography and alpha-fetoprotein, which are less sensitive for early-stage disease. The analytical validation followed CLSI guidelines and included precision and reproducibility assessments across multiple sites and operators. Results showed low coefficients of variation for quantification cycle (Cq) and melting peak temperature (Tm), with all interferents and cross-reactants meeting predefined criteria. These findings establish the analytical precision and specificity of MLDx-s, supporting its potential as a more effective tool for HCC detection. However, the study did not evaluate end-to-end variability in clinical specimens, which may affect real-world performance. The evidence is moderate due to the abstract-only nature of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在验证一种利用循环游离 DNA (cfDNA) 异常甲基化检测肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的血液检测方法,解决超声检查和甲胎蛋白等现有方法不足以进行早期疾病检测的局限性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及 MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s) 的分析验证,该方法使用具有高分辨率熔解 (HRM) 的甲基化特异性 PCR 来检测血浆 cfDNA 中的甲基化 RNF135 和 DNMT3A。验证遵循 CLSI 指南,包括跨多个站点和操作员的精度和可重复性评估。
elements_zh.methods: MLDx-s 的分析验证是使用 CLSI EP05-A3、EP07、EP12-A2 和 EP37 指南进行的。通过一个站点内以及两个站点和两个操作员之间的方差分量分析来评估定量周期 (Cq) 和熔解峰温度 (Tm) 的精度。
elements_zh.main_results: Cq 重复性变异系数 (CV) 范围为 0.53% 至 1.68%,总再现性 CV 范围为 1.10% 至 2.37%。所有 Tm CV 均≤0.20%。此外,所有 18 种干扰物和 16 种微生物交叉反应物均符合预定的验收标准。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果为 MLDx-s 在 HCC 监测 中的使用奠定了基础,为早期检测有限的现有方法(例如超声检查和甲胎蛋白)提供了更灵敏和特异的替代方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的重点是使用参考 DNA 进行分析验证,并未评估临床血浆样本的端到端变异性,这可能会带来额外的不确定性。由于研究结果仅具有抽象性,因此证据强度中等。

title: Modeling Endemic Disease Control Under Conflict Constraints: Regional Government Capacity to Reach Populations Isolated by Warfare in Sudan
abstract: Armed conflict significantly disrupts public health systems, yet the mechanisms linking violence to endemic disease outbreaks remain insufficiently understood. This study examines how violent conflict affects disease governance and health service delivery across Sudan’s conflict-affected regions between 2000 and 2024. Using a spatial panel dataset that combines geo-referenced conflict events from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project (ACLED), epidemiological surveillance records, environmental indicators, and subnational governance measures, the analysis evaluates the relationship between conflict intensity, governance capacity, and endemic disease incidence. The results indicate that areas experiencing higher levels of violence exhibit significantly greater incidence of malaria, cholera, and measles. These effects are particularly pronounced where health infrastructure has been damaged and administrative capacity has weakened. Regions with stronger local governance demonstrate greater resilience, maintaining partial vaccination coverage and disease surveillance despite ongoing conflict. Spatial models further reveal significant spillover effects, with outbreaks spreading along displacement corridors and border regions. The findings highlight the central role of governance capacity in mediating health outcomes during armed conflict and underscore the importance of conflict-sensitive health interventions. Strengthening decentralized health governance, protecting health infrastructure, and improving cross-regional disease surveillance are essential for mitigating endemic disease risks in fragile and conflict-affected settings.
journal: International Journal of Business Ecosystem and Strategy (2687-2293)

title: Exploring enablers and barriers for implementing community-based surveillance strengthening early detection and response in District Mardan Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pakistan
abstract: Community-based surveillance (CBS) compliments early warning alert and response beyond health facilities by identifying events at source through community engagement, enabling detection of disease outbreaks before facility-based reporting systems. In Pakistan, repeated outbreaks of dengue, measles and other infectious diseases highlight the need for event detection at community level. Although community-based surveillance is globally advocated, implementation at district level remains limited. Successful CBS implementation depends on understanding local contexts, stakeholder readiness, and enabling factors. Before implementing CBS in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, this qualitative study assesses implementation readiness by exploring multi-stakeholder perspectives on barriers and enablers. The study engages district health officials, Lady Health Workers, facility staff, and community volunteers to identify contextual factors and strategies needed for effective community participation in outbreak detection and response systems. A qualitative exploratory study was conducted from June to August 2025 in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We conducted five key informant interviews (KIIs) with district officials (DHO, Provincial Coordinator, 3 program managers/officers) and three focus group discussions (FGDs) stratified by stakeholder role including Lady Health Workers (LHWs, n = 17), health facility staff (HFS, n = 13), and community volunteers (CV, n = 15) totaling n = 50 participants. Data were collected using semi-structured guides, audio-recorded with consent, transcribed and analyzed using both inductive and deductive coding in NVivo 12. Data triangulation across four stakeholder groups strengthened credibility of findings. CBS was perceived a value addition in identification of events and to compliment early warning alerts and response component of national surveillance system. Community alerts often go undocumented. Participants described perceived gaps in LHW coverage, particularly in peri-urban and remote areas. Strengthening of CBS implementation included motivated frontline workers, strong community engagement and increasing use of digital tools. Challenges included passive reporting, limited training, weak data integration, and mistrust in vaccination campaigns. Participants recommended revitalizing village health committees, unified real-time reporting, continuous training, and stronger feedback mechanisms. CBS in Mardan provides a promising foundation but remains fragmented. Expanding LHW coverage, strengthening reporting systems, and rebuilding trust with communities are key steps toward more effective early detection and response.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是实施基于社区的 监测 (CBS),以早期发现和应对传染病,包括巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区的 麻疹。核心问题是关于 CBS 实施的准备情况,特别是在确定社区有效参与 暴发 检测和响应系统的障碍和推动因素方面。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项定性探索性研究,于 2025 年 6 月至 8 月在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区进行。数据是通过与地区官员进行的五次关键知情人访谈 (KII) 以及按利益相关者角色分层的三场焦点小组讨论 (FGD) 收集的,包括女性卫生工作者 (LHW,n = 17)、卫生机构工作人员 (HFS,n = 13) 和社区志愿者 (CV,n = 15),总共 n = 50 名参与者。使用 NVivo 12 中的归纳和演绎编码对数据进行分析,并对四个利益相关者群体进行数据三角测量,以增强研究结果的可信度。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了提高CBS的有效性,研究建议振兴村卫生委员会,实施统一的实时报告系统,为一线工作人员提供持续培训,并建立更强有力的反馈机制。这些步骤对于提高该地区的早期检测和响应能力至关重要。

Successful CBS implementation depends on understanding local contexts, stakeholder readiness, and enabling factors. Before implementing CBS in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, this qualitative study assesses implementation readiness by exploring multi-stakeholder perspectives on barriers and enablers. The study engages district health officials, Lady Health Workers, facility staff, and community volunteers to identify contextual factors and strategies needed for effective community participation in outbreak detection and response systems. A qualitative exploratory study was conducted from June to August 2025 in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We conducted five key informant interviews (KIIs) with district officials (DHO, Provincial Coordinator, 3 program managers/officers) and three focus group discussions (FGDs) stratified by stakeholder role including Lady Health Workers (LHWs, n = 17), health facility staff (HFS, n = 13), and community volunteers (CV, n = 15) totaling n = 50 participants. Data were collected using semi-structured guides, audio-recorded with consent, transcribed and analyzed using both inductive and deductive coding in NVivo 12. Data triangulation across four stakeholder groups strengthened credibility of findings. CBS was perceived a value addition in identification of events and to compliment early warning alerts and response component of national surveillance system. Community alerts often go undocumented. Participants described perceived gaps in LHW coverage, particularly in peri-urban and remote areas. Strengthening of CBS implementation included motivated frontline workers, strong community engagement and increasing use of digital tools. Challenges included passive reporting, limited training, weak data integration, and mistrust in vaccination campaigns. Participants recommended revitalizing village health committees, unified real-time reporting, continuous training, and stronger feedback mechanisms. CBS in Mardan provides a promising foundation but remains fragmented. Expanding LHW coverage, strengthening reporting systems, and rebuilding trust with communities are key steps toward more effective early detection and response.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是实施基于社区的 监测 (CBS),以早期发现和应对传染病,包括巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区的 麻疹。核心问题是关于 CBS 实施的准备情况,特别是在确定社区有效参与 暴发 检测和响应系统的障碍和推动因素方面。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项定性探索性研究,于 2025 年 6 月至 8 月在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区进行。数据是通过与地区官员进行的五次关键知情人访谈 (KII) 以及按利益相关者角色分层的三场焦点小组讨论 (FGD) 收集的,包括女性卫生工作者 (LHW,n = 17)、卫生机构工作人员 (HFS,n = 13) 和社区志愿者 (CV,n = 15),总共 n = 50 名参与者。使用 NVivo 12 中的归纳和演绎编码对数据进行分析,并对四个利益相关者群体进行数据三角测量,以增强研究结果的可信度。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 基于社区的 监测 (CBS) 被认为是识别事件和补充国家 监测 系统的早期预警和响应组件的增值功能。然而,CBS 在马尔丹的实施仍然支离破碎,凸显了加强报告系统、增加 LHW 覆盖范围以及重建社区信任的必要性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究指出了被动报告、有限的培训、数据集成薄弱以及对 疫苗接种 活动的不信任等挑战。缺乏记录的社区警报,并且 LHW 覆盖范围存在差距,特别是在城郊和偏远地区。这些问题表明 CBS 实施中存在尚未解决的机制和证据差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了提高CBS的有效性,研究建议振兴村卫生委员会,实施统一的实时报告系统,为一线工作人员提供持续培训,并建立更强有力的反馈机制。这些步骤对于提高该地区的早期检测和响应能力至关重要。

title: The herd immunity attractor: selection, drift, and the steady-state undersupply of vaccination in 195 countries, 1980–2025
abstract: Introduction Vaccination is the canonical positive externality in health economics: because each vaccination protects others, decentralized choice is predicted to stall below the herd immunity threshold. Yet little evidence exists on the law of motion that governs national coverage. This study estimates it directly. Methods I model the vaccinate-or-not decision of a heterogeneous household population as an expected-utility problem whose net payoff declines in the vaccinated share, aggregate it through an explicit revision protocol into a selection-mutation (replicator-mutator) equation in which payoff-responsive switching coexists with health-system contact and attrition hazards, and estimate the resulting equation on the World Health Organization/United Nations Children's Fund (WHO/UNICEF) Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC, 2025 revision) for 195 countries over 1980-2025, with UN cohort denominators and World Bank income and health-system capacity controls. An exact identification result shows that the linear turnover coefficient equals the difference between the law of motion at full and at zero coverage, so it is identified from boundary observations independently of the payoff parameters, whereas the payoff slope is identified only where coverage traverses the simplex. Results First, in the interior of the coverage range, the dynamics are dominated by a strong linear restoring force, implying an annual turnover of 15%–25% of the relevant pool; the payoff slope is statistically weak there, and interior data cannot distinguish institutional flows from payoff-insensitive revision, so the estimated hazards bound the institutional component from above. Second, the free-riding signature appears where it is identified: sharply in the Hib rollout, which spans the full coverage range, and weakly on the first-dose DTP margin. Third, every country's law of motion has a stable interior rest point; the births-weighted world rest point for first-dose measles vaccination is 78%, below the 92%–94% herd band; 74% of countries rest below it, and a coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) era shift lowered the median rest point by 3.3 points. Discussion Because the leverage of retention over payoff instruments equals 1/(1 − x * ) under the replicator protocol and diverges along the last mile under any smooth, bounded choice protocol, closing the gap is a default-and-retention problem rather than a price problem.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the dynamics of vaccination coverage across 195 countries from 1980 to 2025, focusing on the herd immunity threshold and the factors influencing vaccination decisions. It models the vaccinate-or-not decision as an expected-utility problem, incorporating health-system contact and attrition hazards. The results show a strong linear restoring force in the interior of the coverage range, with an annual turnover of 15%–25%. The study also identifies a free-riding signature in the Hib rollout and on the first-dose DTP margin. The findings suggest that closing the vaccination gap is a default-and-retention problem rather than a price problem. The analysis highlights that the world rest point for first-dose measles vaccination is 78%, below the herd band, with a significant shift due to the COVID-19 era. The study's evidence is based on WHO/UNICEF data and includes controls for income and health-system capacity, but the limitations are not explicitly detailed in the supplied evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 疫苗接种 是卫生经济学中典型的正外部性:因为每个 疫苗接种 都保护其他人,所以预计去中心化选择将停滞在群体免疫阈值以下。提供的证据并未报告该研究解决的具体科学或公共卫生问题。

title_zh: 群体免疫吸引子:1980-2025 年 195 个国家 疫苗接种 的选择、漂移和稳态供应不足
source_body_en: Introduction Vaccination is the canonical positive externality in health economics: because each vaccination protects others, decentralized choice is predicted to stall below the herd immunity threshold. Yet little evidence exists on the law of motion that governs national coverage. This study estimates it directly. Methods I model the vaccinate-or-not decision of a heterogeneous household population as an expected-utility problem whose net payoff declines in the vaccinated share, aggregate it through an explicit revision protocol into a selection-mutation (replicator-mutator) equation in which payoff-responsive switching coexists with health-system contact and attrition hazards, and estimate the resulting equation on the World Health Organization/United Nations Children's Fund (WHO/UNICEF) Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC, 2025 revision) for 195 countries over 1980-2025, with UN cohort denominators and World Bank income and health-system capacity controls. An exact identification result shows that the linear turnover coefficient equals the difference between the law of motion at full and at zero coverage, so it is identified from boundary observations independently of the payoff parameters, whereas the payoff slope is identified only where coverage traverses the simplex. Results First, in the interior of the coverage range, the dynamics are dominated by a strong linear restoring force, implying an annual turnover of 15%–25% of the relevant pool; the payoff slope is statistically weak there, and interior data cannot distinguish institutional flows from payoff-insensitive revision, so the estimated hazards bound the institutional component from above. Second, the free-riding signature appears where it is identified: sharply in the Hib rollout, which spans the full coverage range, and weakly on the first-dose DTP margin. Third, every country's law of motion has a stable interior rest point; the births-weighted world rest point for first-dose measles vaccination is 78%, below the 92%–94% herd band; 74% of countries rest below it, and a coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) era shift lowered the median rest point by 3.3 points. Discussion Because the leverage of retention over payoff instruments equals 1/(1 − x * ) under the replicator protocol and diverges along the last mile under any smooth, bounded choice protocol, closing the gap is a default-and-retention problem rather than a price problem.

title: Identification of Mpox Skin Lesion Images Based on Deep Learning Classification Models
abstract: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) is a rare zoonotic disease that can cause skin lesions and has the potential for global spread. With the deepening integration of computer science and medicine, intelligent disease detection models based on deep learning and neural networks have become important auxiliary tools for enhancing clinical diagnosis and treatment. This study conducted a comparative analysis of the performance of mainstream deep learning classification models,VGG19, ResNet50, DenseNet201, GoogLeNet, and ConvNeXt_B,in the task of mpox skin image recognition. For the binary classification task, images were categorized into a “Mpox” class and an “Others” class, where the latter includes chickenpox and measles cases, given that their initial rash and pustule presentations closely resemble those of mpox. Beyond quantitative performance evaluation, this study further employed GradCAM++ to generate class activation heatmaps, providing visual interpretability of model decision-making. The resulting heatmaps offer critical clinical diagnostic value by highlighting key lesion regions, thereby enhancing model transparency and supporting clinicians in validating predictions. The experimental results indicate that under identical model parameters and learning rates, the ResNet50 model achieved higher classification accuracy and inference speed, demonstrating its application potential for accurate diagnosis in mpox and other disease image recognition tasks.
journal: Frontiers in artificial intelligence and applications

elements_en.methods: The study employed deep learning classification models to recognize mpox skin images, with a focus on evaluating their performance. It also used GradCAM++ to generate class activation heatmaps, providing visual interpretability of model decision-making.
elements_en.main_results: The study found that under identical model parameters and learning rates, the ResNet50 model achieved higher classification accuracy and inference speed compared to other models.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as demonstrating the potential of ResNet50 for accurate diagnosis in mpox and other disease image recognition tasks, highlighting its superior performance in terms of accuracy and speed.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more effective diagnostic tools for mpox, aiding in early detection and improving clinical decision-making processes.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level evidence and does not provide detailed experimental results or statistical analyses, which may affect the strength of the conclusions.

title_zh: 基于深度学习分类模型的痘痘皮损图像识别
source_body_en: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) is a rare zoonotic disease that can cause skin lesions and has the potential for global spread. With the deepening integration of computer science and medicine, intelligent disease detection models based on deep learning and neural networks have become important auxiliary tools for enhancing clinical diagnosis and treatment. This study conducted a comparative analysis of the performance of mainstream deep learning classification models,VGG19, ResNet50, DenseNet201, GoogLeNet, and ConvNeXt_B,in the task of mpox skin image recognition. For the binary classification task, images were categorized into a “Mpox” class and an “Others” class, where the latter includes chickenpox and measles cases, given that their initial rash and pustule presentations closely resemble those of mpox. Beyond quantitative performance evaluation, this study further employed GradCAM++ to generate class activation heatmaps, providing visual interpretability of model decision-making. The resulting heatmaps offer critical clinical diagnostic value by highlighting key lesion regions, thereby enhancing model transparency and supporting clinicians in validating predictions. The experimental results indicate that under identical model parameters and learning rates, the ResNet50 model achieved higher classification accuracy and inference speed, demonstrating its application potential for accurate diagnosis in mpox and other disease image recognition tasks.
abstract_zh: Mpox(以前称为猴痘)是一种罕见的人畜共患疾病,可引起皮肤损伤,并有可能在全球传播。随着计算机科学与医学的不断深入融合,基于深度学习和神经网络的智能疾病检测模型已成为增强临床诊断和治疗的重要辅助工具。本研究对主流深度学习分类模型VGG19、ResNet50、DenseNet201、GoogLeNet、ConvNeXt_B在mpox皮肤图像识别任务中的性能进行了对比分析。对于二元分类任务,图像被分为“Mpox”类和“其他”类,其中后者包括水痘和 麻疹 病例,因为它们最初的皮疹和脓疱表现与 MPOX 非常相似。除了定量性能评估之外,本研究还进一步利用 GradCAM++ 生成类激活热图,提供模型决策的可视化可解释性。由此产生的热图通过突出显示关键病变区域来提供重要的临床诊断价值,从而提高模型透明度并支持临床医生验证预测。实验结果表明,在相同的模型参数和学习率下,ResNet50模型取得了更高的分类精度和推理速度,展示了其在mpox等疾病图像识别任务中精确诊断的应用潜力。

title: Does a prenatal consultation dedicated to fathers’ health widen men’s access to prevention and care?
abstract: Prenatal care provides expectant mothers with regular healthcare access, yet no equivalent preventative framework exists for expectant fathers. The PARTAGE project evaluated a dedicated prenatal consultation for future fathers aimed at health preservation and improvement. We describe the clinical outcomes of this consultation and identify factors associated with these outcomes. PARTAGE was a monocentric interventional study without control arm launched in a large public maternity ward in a northeastern suburb of Paris, an area where immigration prevails. Eligible pregnant women were offered to give their partner contact details. Among 2516 eligible future fathers who were successfully contacted, 1333 were included; fourteen others sought the consultation directly. A physician or a midwife held a medical interview, prescribed immediate biological tests, administered vaccination catch-up, and offered healthcare and social referral depending on participants' needs. Paternal prenatal consultations resulted in prevention, diagnosis and linkage into care: 37% of participants had never been tested for HIV; 96% had not been tested during or immediately prior to the current pregnancy, of whom only 1% refused HIV screening; 72% were out-of-date for pertussis or measles vaccinations, of whom 60% received an on-site catch-up. In addition, 18% had at least one pathology diagnosed or brought back into care; 17% were referred to healthcare professionals and 11% to social workers. In multivariate analysis, being born in Sub Saharan Africa rather than in France and having no health insurance coverage rather than a complete one were associated with a medical diagnosis (OR 2.67 [1.80-3.98] and OR 2.58 [1.63-4.09], respectively) and with a referral to a healthcare professional (OR 2.67 [1.80-3.98] and OR 3.63 [2.27-5.80], respectively). PARTAGE led to HIV screening and vaccinations catch-up across the whole study population. It also enabled the diagnosis of undetected illnesses and to the resumption of care for pathologies that had already been diagnosed but were previously lost to follow-up, especially in the most socially disadvantaged future fathers. Addressing men’s health during their partner’s pregnancy may help reduce gender and social inequalities in health. NCT05085717; Registry: ClinicalTrials.gov, US National Library of Medicine https://classic.clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT05085717 (retrospectively registered). Registration date: 20 October 2021. Protocol is available as additional file 1.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate a dedicated prenatal consultation for expectant fathers to improve health outcomes and address health disparities. Prenatal care for mothers is well-established, but no equivalent framework exists for fathers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The PARTAGE project was a monocentric interventional study in a large public maternity ward in a northeastern suburb of Paris, focusing on 1333 future fathers who were contacted and 14 who sought the consultation directly.
analysis.methods: The study involved a medical interview, prescribed biological tests, vaccinations, and referrals to healthcare and social services based on participants' needs.
analysis.main_results: Among participants, 37% had never been tested for HIV, 96% had not been tested during or immediately prior to the current pregnancy, and 72% were out-of-date for pertussis or measles vaccinations, with 60% receiving catch-up vaccinations. Additionally, 18% had undiagnosed pathologies, 17% were referred to healthcare professionals, and 11% to social workers.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that paternal prenatal consultations led to significant prevention, diagnosis, and linkage into care, particularly for socially disadvantaged men. Being born in Sub-Saharan Africa or having no health insurance coverage was associated with higher rates of medical diagnosis and referral to healthcare professionals.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that addressing men’s health during their partner’s pregnancy can help reduce gender and social inequalities in health, particularly in areas with high immigration.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its monocentric design and lack of a control group, which may affect generalizability. The results are based on observational data and may be subject to confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: The PARTAGE project evaluated a dedicated prenatal consultation for expectant fathers, leading to significant prevention, diagnosis, and linkage into care. The study found that paternal prenatal consultations were particularly beneficial for socially disadvantaged men, with higher rates of medical diagnosis and referral to healthcare professionals among those born in Sub-Saharan Africa or without health insurance coverage.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: PARAGE 项目是在巴黎东北郊的一个大型公共产房进行的一项单中心介入研究,重点关注了 1333 名被联系的未来父亲以及 14 名直接寻求咨询的人。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究涉及医学访谈、规定的生物测试、疫苗接种 以及根据参与者的需求转介至医疗保健和社会服务。
elements_zh.main_results: 在参与者中,37% 的人从未接受过 HIV 检测,96% 的人在当前怀孕期间或之前没有接受过检测,72% 的人未接受过百日咳或 麻疹 麻疹 疫苗接种 的检测,60% 的人接受了补充 疫苗接种。此外,18% 的人患有未确诊的病症,17% 的人被转介给医疗保健专业人员,11% 的人被转介给社会工作者。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,父亲的产前咨询可以起到显着的预防作用,并与护理挂钩,特别是对于社会弱势男性。出生在撒哈拉以南非洲地区或没有健康保险与较高的医疗 诊断 率和转诊至医疗保健专业人员有关。

title_zh: 专门针对父亲健康的产前咨询是否可以扩大男性获得预防和护理的机会?
source_body_en: Prenatal care provides expectant mothers with regular healthcare access, yet no equivalent preventative framework exists for expectant fathers. The PARTAGE project evaluated a dedicated prenatal consultation for future fathers aimed at health preservation and improvement. We describe the clinical outcomes of this consultation and identify factors associated with these outcomes. PARTAGE was a monocentric interventional study without control arm launched in a large public maternity ward in a northeastern suburb of Paris, an area where immigration prevails. Eligible pregnant women were offered to give their partner contact details. Among 2516 eligible future fathers who were successfully contacted, 1333 were included; fourteen others sought the consultation directly. A physician or a midwife held a medical interview, prescribed immediate biological tests, administered vaccination catch-up, and offered healthcare and social referral depending on participants' needs. Paternal prenatal consultations resulted in prevention, diagnosis and linkage into care: 37% of participants had never been tested for HIV; 96% had not been tested during or immediately prior to the current pregnancy, of whom only 1% refused HIV screening; 72% were out-of-date for pertussis or measles vaccinations, of whom 60% received an on-site catch-up. In addition, 18% had at least one pathology diagnosed or brought back into care; 17% were referred to healthcare professionals and 11% to social workers. In multivariate analysis, being born in Sub Saharan Africa rather than in France and having no health insurance coverage rather than a complete one were associated with a medical diagnosis (OR 2.67 [1.80-3.98] and OR 2.58 [1.63-4.09], respectively) and with a referral to a healthcare professional (OR 2.67 [1.80-3.98] and OR 3.63 [2.27-5.80], respectively). PARTAGE led to HIV screening and vaccinations catch-up across the whole study population. It also enabled the diagnosis of undetected illnesses and to the resumption of care for pathologies that had already been diagnosed but were previously lost to follow-up, especially in the most socially disadvantaged future fathers. Addressing men’s health during their partner’s pregnancy may help reduce gender and social inequalities in health. NCT05085717; Registry: ClinicalTrials.gov, US National Library of Medicine https://classic.clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT05085717 (retrospectively registered). Registration date: 20 October 2021. Protocol is available as additional file 1.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估针对准父亲的专门产前咨询,以改善健康结果并解决健康差异。对母亲的产前护理很完善,但对父亲却没有同等的框架。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: PARAGE 项目是在巴黎东北郊的一个大型公共产房进行的一项单中心介入研究,重点关注了 1333 名被联系的未来父亲以及 14 名直接寻求咨询的人。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究涉及医学访谈、规定的生物测试、疫苗接种 以及根据参与者的需求转介至医疗保健和社会服务。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在参与者中,37% 的人从未接受过 HIV 检测,96% 的人在当前怀孕期间或之前没有接受过检测,72% 的人未接受过百日咳或 麻疹 麻疹 疫苗接种 的检测,60% 的人接受了补充 疫苗接种。此外,18% 的人患有未确诊的病症,17% 的人被转介给医疗保健专业人员,11% 的人被转介给社会工作者。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,父亲的产前咨询可以起到显着的预防作用,并与护理挂钩,特别是对于社会弱势男性。出生在撒哈拉以南非洲地区或没有健康保险与较高的医疗 诊断 率和转诊至医疗保健专业人员有关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,解决男性伴侣怀孕期间的健康问题有助于减少健康方面的性别和社会不平等,特别是在移民较多的地区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心设计和缺乏对照组而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。结果基于观察数据,可能会受到混杂因素的影响。

title: Prediction Uncertainty Controlled Computer Model Calibration
abstract: Computer-model calibration is usually undertaken in service of prediction, yet neither Bayesian Kennedy-O'Hagan (KOH) calibration nor amortized simulation-based inference is built to control the predictive error of the calibrated simulator. When parameters are weakly identified or the data-model discrepancy is misspecified, the simulator-output bands induced by a nominal posterior level can be far from nominal. We propose a two-layer framework that targets predictive miscoverage directly. First, a conditional flow-matching model learns an amortized posterior for the calibration parameters, trained on simulator outputs perturbed with Gaussian-process discrepancies of varying structure. Second, conformal risk control arranges posterior draws for the target observation into nested candidate sets and selects the smallest one whose fixed-rank pointwise bands attain a prescribed time-averaged miscoverage on a synthetic calibration sample. Under exchangeability of calibration and target observations, the bands control expected miscoverage in finite samples. In a synthetic benchmark, the proposed bands are roughly 20% the width of KOH-MCMC bands with miscoverage near the 10% target. In calibrating an age-structured SEIR model to the 2010 Malawi measles outbreak, they are again sharper and near-nominal, and the weeks they fail to cover coincide with the asymmetric epidemic decline, exposing structural inadequacy of the mechanistic model.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to synthetic benchmarks and a single real-world measles outbreak, which may affect generalizability. The evidence is strong, as the framework was validated on both simulated and empirical data, showing consistent performance.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a two-layer framework for computer-model calibration aimed at directly controlling predictive miscoverage. The authors highlight that existing methods, such as Bayesian Kennedy-O'Hagan (KOH) calibration and amortized simulation-based inference, are inadequate when parameters are weakly identified or data-model discrepancy is misspecified. The framework combines a conditional flow-matching model with conformal risk control to produce narrower predictive bands with near-target miscoverage. When applied to a synthetic benchmark and the 2010 Malawi measles outbreak, the method demonstrated improved precision, though it failed to cover certain weeks during the asymmetric decline of the epidemic, indicating potential structural limitations in the mechanistic model. The study's results suggest that the framework could enhance the accuracy of predictive models in epidemiology, particularly for measles, with strong evidence from both simulated and empirical data. However, the limited scope to a single outbreak may restrict generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过提出一个直接控制预测错误覆盖的新框架来解决计算机模型现有校准方法的局限性。背景强调,当参数识别较弱或数据模型差异指定错误时,贝叶斯肯尼迪-奥哈根 (KOH) 校准和基于摊销的模拟推理都无法充分管理预测误差。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及综合基准以及针对 2010 年马拉维 麻疹 暴发 的年龄结构 SEIR 模型的校准。它的重点是评估所提议的框架在这​​些特定背景下的性能。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括一个两层框架:首先,使用条件流匹配模型来学习校准参数的摊销后验,并在具有高斯过程差异的模拟器输出上进行训练。其次,应用保形风险控制将后验抽签安排到嵌套的候选集中,选择实现规定的时间平均错误覆盖的最小集。
elements_zh.main_results: 在综合基准中,建议的频带比 KOH-MCMC 频带窄约 20%,误覆盖率接近 10% 的目标。当应用于 2010 年马拉维 麻疹 麻疹 暴发 时,这些区间更加尖锐且接近名义值,尽管它们未能覆盖非对称流行病下降期间的某些周。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为证明他们的框架在可交换性假设下有效控制了有限样本中的预测错误覆盖。新颖之处在于通过两层方法直接针对预测性错误覆盖,提供比现有方法更高的精度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对于提高流行病学研究中使用的预测模型的准确性具有重要意义,特别是对于 麻疹 等疾病,精确的预测对于公共卫生干预措施至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于综合基准和单个现实世界的 麻疹 暴发,这可能会影响普遍性。证据是强有力的,因为该框架在模拟和经验数据上都得到了验证,显示出一致的性能。
